alexa (marketing): Quick sync — we need a single chorded timeline for the release announce, docs links, and webinar signups. Goal: coordinate engineering changelog push + staged publish so the marketing post doesn't link to stale docs.

sam (eng): on it. what's the target publish window?

alexa (marketing): aiming for Tue 10:00 PT. want docs live + changelog committed an hour before, and canary rollout at 09:45. can we do that? @sam

sam (eng): 10:00 PT ok. I'll have the changelog PR merged by 08:50 and the deploy pipeline scheduled. release-bot will post deploy status.

release-bot: automated: changelog-pr #542 merged by sam at 3187654300. staging deploy queued.

maria (product): Heads-up — we changed one line in the feature description (example use case) yesterday. Marketing copy needs to reflect that — i'll paste snippet here: 

maria (product): "Redwood API now supports streaming structured tool outputs with stable tokens-per-second guarantees for prioritized routes."

kai (growth): Good call, maria. We'll iterate the tweet/webinar hooks to use "streaming structured tool outputs" wording. Also want a 1-line benchmark highlight: can we pull a low-latency stat?

sam (eng): for the default model profile, 95th percentile token latency is ~45ms on dedicated pools at seq_len=256. We can surface a concise stat: "P95 token latency <50ms on Dedicated" if that helps.

alexa (marketing): perfect — use maria's phrase + the latency stat. Kai, plan webinar CTA with registration link placeholder and we'll swap in final URL.

jordan (ops): For inbound lead routing: once the post goes live, please tag leads from webinar signups to the "paid-ops" queue for follow-up. Kai, can you confirm fields we need on the form (company size, use case, region)?

kai (growth): form fields: company, work email, company size (dropdown), primary use case (free text), region (dropdown). We'll forward webhooks to /webhooks/marketing/leadsignup and route by region header.

sam (eng): webhook endpoint looks good. ops: should we throttle to avoid spikes during the announcement?

jordan (ops): yes — we'll put a 5r/s burst limit and backpressure to a retry queue. I will add that rule before 09:30.

alexa (marketing): Checklist so far: 
- changelog merged by 08:50 (sam)
- docs publish + canonical links live by 09:00 (sam + docs infra)
- canary rollout 09:45 (sam)
- public post 10:00 PT (alexa)
- webinar CTA + reg form live at publish (kai)
- lead webhook + routing rules in place by 09:30 (jordan)
- copy updates (maria) merged by 09:00 (maria)

maria (product): I pushed the final copy to the marketing doc, link: https://redwood-internal.docs/release/3187 (please reference it).

kai (growth): I'll prep the landing page with a placeholder CTA url and swap on publish. Also scheduling a 30-min pre-announcement email for partners at 09:50.

sam (eng): quick note — there's a small DB migration in the docs publish pipeline. It's low-risk but I'll run a smoke job at 08:30 and post logs here.

release-bot: automated: smoke job started at 3187654500. status: queued.

alexa (marketing): thanks everyone. if any timing shifts >10 minutes, drop a quick note here and i'll update the scheduled social posts. :thumbsup:

sam (eng): smoke job successful at 3187654560. staging docs live at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/streaming-output-3187 

jordan (ops): webhook throttling rule added.

kai (growth): partner email queued for 09:50. landing page ready.

alexa (marketing): green across the board. i'll start the publish sequence at 09:55 and trigger social/announce at 10:00 PT. thanks all! :rocket:
